# Cūḷataṇhāsaṅkhaya Sutta (MN 37 (PTS MN i 251))

**ID:** MN 37 (PTS MN i 251)  
**Section:** Majjhimanikāya (mn)  
**Collection:** Sutta  
**Title (Pali):** Cūḷataṇhāsaṅkhaya Sutta  
**PTS:** MN i 251  
**tipitaka.org (CST):** [https://tipitaka.org/romn/cscd/s0201m.mul3.xml](https://tipitaka.org/romn/cscd/s0201m.mul3.xml)

## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

 Textual analysis demonstrates that while the narrative core tallies with the Chinese EĀ parallel, the EĀ version renders the core detachment formula through the language of emptiness (*śūnyatā*) and insubstantiality [Meisig 2010].

**Parallels and text reuse**

- Full parallels: EA 19.3 斷愛; SA 505 愛盡
- Passage-level parallels: AN 7.61 Pacalāyamānasutta; MA 83 長老上尊睡眠; T 47 離睡

**Sources**

- [Anālayo 2006] Bhikkhu Anālayo, From Craving to Liberation (2006) — Details on Sakka's inquiry and the Buddha's core doctrinal formula (sabbe dhammā nālaṁ abhinivesāya).
- [Buswell & Lopez 2014] Robert E. Buswell Jr. & Donald S. Lopez Jr., The Princeton Dictionary of Buddhism (2014) — Dictionary summary of the sutta's number, contents, characters, and recensions.
- [Kingsbury 2002] Paul Kingsbury, Chronology of the Pali Canon: The Case of the Aorists (2002) — Discussion of the sutta's mythological elements and Moggallāna's exploits.
- [Meisig 2010] Konrad Meisig, Translating Buddhist Chinese: Problems and Prospects (2010) — Comparison of the central doctrinal formula with its parallel in the Ekottarika Āgama.
- [Ñāṇamoli & Bodhi 1995] Bhikkhu Ñāṇamoli & Bhikkhu Bodhi, The Middle Length Discourses of the Buddha (1995) — Setting at the Palace of Migāra's Mother and overview of Moggallāna's overhearing of the discourse.
- [Nyanaponika et al. 2003] Nyanaponika Thera, Hellmuth Hecker & Bhikkhu Bodhi, Great Disciples of the Buddha (2003) — Narrative details of Moggallāna's celestial visit and the shaking of the Vejayanta Palace.
- [Piya Tan 2008] Piya Tan, Maha Parinibbana Sutta (2004, 2008) — Contextualization of Moggallāna's action as an instigation of spiritual urgency (saṁvega).
- [Rogell 2003] Sharda Rogell, Pressing Out Pure Honey: A Practitioner's Study Guide (2003) — Summary of the teaching on feelings and non-clinging.
